fact: Libya Herald reports the LIBIGPT project, the first generative AI model in Libya, implemented by Smart Co for Technology Projects and Artificial Intelligence, was announced in Tripoli.
The Audit Bureau head said Diwan Bot, an institutional AI model, was designed and developed entirely by young national talent in a project begun at the start of 2026; no release is stated.

The National Authority for Information Security and Safety developed the Nissa AI assistant in about four months on Google's open-source Gemma 3, trained on the Authority's own knowledge base, and opened it for public testing.
Libya's Ministry of Economy and Trade announced the launch of LIBI GPT, described as Libya's first generative AI model, implemented by the company Smart Co.
